analysis.reason: 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. RSI는 과매도 구간 탈출 후 중립 구간 안착, MACD 히스토그램은 약세 수렴 구간에서 개선세 확인. 그러나 SMA20(252,650원) 하향 이탈 및 볼린저밴드 중단(252,650원) 부근에서 횡보하며 방향성 부재. 거래량비 0.49로 매수세 유입 미약.
analysis.reasonEn: Maintained a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive trading days. RSI has exited oversold territory and settled in the neutral zone, with MACD histogram showing improvement from a weak convergence. However, the price is trading below SMA20 ($252,650) and sideways near the Bollinger Band middle line ($252,650), indicating a lack of direction. Trading volume ratio of 0.49 suggests weak buying pressure.

· RSI 궤적 (33.8→45.9) — 과매도 탈출 후 중립 구간 진입, 상승 방향성 확인
· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (-5410.1222→970.2969) — 약세 수렴 구간에서 개선세 확인, 바닥 다지기 신호
· 볼린저밴드 현재가 위치 (중단 252,650원) — 중단 부근 횡보, 밴드폭 33.97%로 변동성 축소
[지지·저항 구조]
· 스윙 지지선 (240,000원) — 피벗(245,067원) 및 SMA5(239,000원) 기반
· 스윙 저항선 (370,000원) — 52주 고가(374,500원)와 인접
· 5일 고가(267,000원)/저가(202,000원), 20일 고가(300,000원)/저가(189,200원) — Higher Low 패턴 진행 중
[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 (0.49배) — 5일 평균 대비 위축, 움직임 신뢰도 하락

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($246,000) above SMA5 ($239,000), below SMA20 ($252,650) — short-term trend turning weak, below mid-term trend.
· Below SMA100 ($259,211), above SMA200 ($194,937) — mid-to-long-term trend shows weak dominance.
· 52-week position (58.1%) + current price level at historical midpoint.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (33.8→45.9) — exiting oversold, entering neutral zone, upward momentum confirmed.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-5410.1222→970.2969) — improving from weak convergence, bottoming signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (middle line $252,650) — sideways near middle line, band width 33.97% indicating reduced volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($240,000) — based on Pivot ($245,067) and SMA5 ($239,000).
· Swing resistance ($370,000) — adjacent to 52-week high ($374,500).
· 5-day high ($267,000)/low ($202,000), 20-day high ($300,000)/low ($189,200) — Higher Low pattern in progress.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.49x) — contracted compared to 5-day average, reducing confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation Zone) — RSI improvement and MACD histogram uptrend confirmed, but lack of direction due to absent volume and trading below SMA20. Maintaining a wait-and-see stance, requiring confirmation of break above $240,000 support and $252,650 SMA20.
